'''Hurada''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed at the [[Voss Orbital Station]] as part of the [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] security. Hurada delievered a message from [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Jannik (Human)|Jannik]] to a prominent Republic individual, who intended to travel to [[Voss]].
